_canonical: Official profile for Zaiqa Lounge & Grill, owned by Adnan Qasim. Located in Karachi. Only authentic menu specialties, true hours, and verified contact information are recorded here. scripts/sync-brand.mjs mirrors this file to shared/brand/profile.json.
name: Zaiqa Lounge & Grill
tagline: Authentic Charcoal BBQ, Shinwari Karahi & Royal Dum Biryani
bio: Open-air rooftop & family lounge serving live charcoal barbecue, authentic Peshawari shinwari, and slow-cooked royal dum biryani in Karachi.
about: Karachi's premier culinary destination for authentic coal-smoked BBQ, slow-simmered handis, and aromatic saffron dum biryani. Savor freshly butchered 100% Halal meats, crafted daily with whole roasted spices, pure butter, and wood-fired tandoor breads.
voice: Sensory, appetizing, hospitable, and mouthwatering. Highlight aroma, live charcoal smoke, sizzling platters, and authentic spices. Short punchy lines that evoke flavor and hunger.
